_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Terraria eggs in https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-standalone and https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Terraria
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The 2D sandbox adventure game. Installs the chosen version of the official dedicated server from terraria.org and creates the world on first start; worlds and serverconfig.txt are kept.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Terraria: downloads the chosen dedicated server from terraria.org. Worlds
# and serverconfig.txt are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
api=https://terraria.org/api
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "Terraria's Linux server is only built for x86-64 (amd64) CPUs, and this node is $(uname -m)."

latest=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$api/get/dedicated-servers-names" | jq -r '.[0]' | grep -oE '[0-9]+') ||
    fail "terraria.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
version="${TERRARIA_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    num=$latest
else
    num=${version//./}  # 1.4.5.8 is file 1458
fi
code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --retry 3 -A "$ua" -r 0-0 "$api/download/pc-dedicated-server/terraria-server-$num.zip") ||
    fail "terraria.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
case $code in 200|206) ;; *) fail "terraria.org has no server for Terraria $version. Set Version to latest, or to a version such as $(sed -E 's/(.)/\1./g; s/\.$//' <<<"$latest").";; esac
pretty=$(sed -E 's/(.)/\1./g; s/\.$//' <<<"$num")

if [ "$(cat .raptor-terraria 2>/dev/null)" = "$num" ] && [ -x TerrariaServer.bin.x86_64 ]; then
    echo "Terraria $pretty is already installed."
else
    build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build"
    trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
    echo "Downloading Terraria $pretty"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/server.zip" "$api/download/pc-dedicated-server/terraria-server-$num.zip"
    unzip -tq "$build/server.zip" >/dev/null || fail "The download from terraria.org is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/server.zip" -d "$build/x"
    src=$(find "$build/x" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name Linux | head -n1)
    [ -n "$src" ] || fail "terraria.org's download has no Linux server in it."
    cp -a "$src/." .
    chmod +x TerrariaServer.bin.x86_64
    echo "$num" > .raptor-terraria
fi

mkdir -p saves/Worlds
if [ ! -f serverconfig.txt ]; then
    cat > serverconfig.txt <<'CFG'
worldpath=/home/container/saves/Worlds
worldname=world
world=/home/container/saves/Worlds/world.wld
autocreate=1
difficulty=0
port=7777
maxplayers=8
CFG
fi
echo "Installed Terraria $pretty."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Terraria version to install, such as 1.4.5.8 or 1458, or latest.

variables.name: World name
variables.description: The world's name, and its file in saves/Worlds. A new world is made when there's none by this name.

variables.name: World size
variables.description: The size of a new world: 1 small, 2 medium, 3 large.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: The difficulty of a new world: 0 classic, 1 expert, 2 master, 3 journey.

variables.name: World seed
variables.description: The seed for a new world. Empty picks one at random.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: The message players see when they join.

variables.name: NPC stream
variables.description: Sends enemies more often when lower, so they skip less, at the cost of bandwidth. 0 turns it off; the game's default is 60.
